description: Per-file provenance contract for every vendored OpenHands UI file. Enforced by scripts/check-agent-upstream-adoption.mjs (G5, G9).
rule: Disk <-> provenance exact 1:1 equality; each provenance entry must belong to an approved source-scope path; strict per-entry repository/tag/commit/path/class/hash validation. G5 does not assert full source-scope adoption closure — that gets its own explicit resolution contract at actual vendor time.

entry_shape.upstream_path: src/... (path within OpenHands repo at the frozen ref; must equal a source-scope entry of classification REQUIRED_VENDOR/REQUIRED_TRANSITIVE/PARTIAL_SURGICAL)
entry_shape.local_path: apps/workspace/upstream/openhands/src/... (path in Xingwen; must resolve inside that root, no traversal)
entry_shape.upstream_source_sha256: 64-char lowercase hex sha256 of the exact upstream file at the frozen ref (must equal source-scope source_sha256)
entry_shape.vendored_sha256: 64-char lowercase hex sha256 of the vendored file after minimal adaptation (must equal actual on-disk file hash)
entry_shape.modified: boolean; false => vendored_sha256 == upstream_source_sha256; true => modification_reason required
entry_shape.modification_reason: null when modified=false; non-empty string when modified=true

source_of_truth: GitHub official repository + Tag v1.10.0 + 40-char SHA + this lock. Not any local clone.
